user.title: Set up lawn
user.description: Select your existing OpenWeatherMap weather entity. The assistant only gives recommendations and does not control irrigation.

data.name: Name
data.initial_gts: Current grassland temperature sum (0 for automatic start)

data_description.initial_gts: If installing during the year, enter a known starting value here. From the next January 1, the integration starts automatically at 0.
data_description.temperature_entity: This sensor has priority. If it is not selected or is unavailable, the current OpenWeatherMap temperature is used automatically.
data_description.mowed_entity: An off-to-on transition records mowing and acknowledges the mowing season. Without a selection, use the manual button.
data_description.watered_entity: An off-to-on transition records watering and updates the soil model. Without a selection, use the manual button.
data_description.precipitation_entity: Accepts precipitation depth or precipitation intensity. Without a sensor, no rain is added to the soil model; forecasts are used only for recommendations.
data_description.soil_moisture_entity: Gently calibrates the modeled soil reservoir toward the measured percentage every six hours. Without a sensor, the model continues independently.
data_description.default_watering_amount: Amount added to the soil model when watering is recorded and no calculated recommendation is available.
data_description.initial_soil_moisture: Starting value of the virtual soil reservoir. For normal loamy soil, 70% is a reasonable initial estimate.
